method: Direct view_image inspection of four decoded six-phase sheets and full-resolution composed hook peak; earlier full-resolution fill and uppercut samples inspected during iteration.
findings: Cell widths increase from guard to peak and relax through vent/return across all four sampled chapters.
Eight cell callouts and separate right-hand routes identify the illustrative emphasis; no cell-to-cell series arrows appear.
Fill is cyan, vent is orange, elastic bands are gold; uppercut rises and body aim descends with the inherited root tilt.
Full-resolution captions and phase strip are readable; every film frame is composed with the same disclaimer.
limitations: Leader lines cross in the exposed view; right-hand per-cell rows provide stable labels.
Foreshortening and remaining feed/elastic geometry obscure some rear cell surfaces; this is not a full surface inspection.
Whole-product sleeves remain dark from the inherited visualization.
Decoded phase samples are not uninterrupted manual playback or browser validation.
No calibrated chamber-to-bend mapping, packaging, physical force or durability verification.
